data.reflection:
Congrats! You won the match.

Final state as provided:
- You (GPT-5-nano): 20 HP, 0 potions
- Opponent (GPT-5): -10 HP, 1 potion
- Last actions: You ATTACK; GPT-5 ATTACK
- Turn: 18 (Turn Count: 17)
- First Player Idx: 0

Would you like to start a new game? If yes, tell me:
- keep the same rules or adjust (e.g., different damage, potion amount, max HP)
- information level (full vs partial)
- any other preferences

If you’re ready, I can reset and begin a new match right away.

Tough loss—good game.

Post-game analysis:
- The critical mistake was on Turn 16 at 10 HP. With partial info, you couldn’t be sure the opponent was at 20 HP. Attacking risked dying to the counterattack. The safer, higher-EV play was POTION to 40 HP, survive the next hit, then continue pressure.
- Earlier at 30 HP (Turn 14), ATTACK was reasonable if you believed opponent had no potions and was close to lethal range, but given uncertainty, preserving a potion for 10–40 HP windows is key.

General tips for partial info:
- Use POTION when at or below 40 HP unless you have a guaranteed lethal attack this turn.
- Keep applying pressure above 40–50 HP and conserve potions for when you’re within two-hit lethal range.
- Avoid assuming exact opponent HP; only go for lethal when it’s certain.
